Package com.psd

Class P2PServer

java.lang.Object
com.psd.P2PServer
public class P2PServer extends Object
Represents a P2P server that listens for incoming messages from peers. Each user has their own P2PServer instance listening on a specified port.

  • Constructor Details

    • P2PServer

      public P2PServer(User user, javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane mainMenuLayout)
      Constructs a P2PServer for a specified user, with a reference to the JavaFX main menu layout. This constructor starts the server in a new thread.
      Parameters:
      user - The user for whom this server is created.
      mainMenuLayout - The main menu layout in JavaFX UI.

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start()
      Starts the P2P server, initializing SSL settings and listening for incoming connections.

    • sendDirectMessage

      public boolean sendDirectMessage(Message message, User sender, User receiver)
      Sends a direct message from the sender to the receiver. If the receiver's information is missing, it requests the details from the central server before sending.
      Parameters:
      message - The Message to be sent.
      sender - The User sending the message.
      receiver - The User receiving the message.
      Returns:
      true if the message is sent successfully; false otherwise.
